name: rust-engineering
description: Implement, refactor, and review production Rust code with clear domain models and maintainable module boundaries.

interface.longDescription: Implement, refactor, and review production Rust code. Prioritize clear domain models, good module boundaries, explicit ownership, testable behavior, and dependencies that reduce maintained code. Includes design examples and crate selection guidance.
